2026-10-23-141.title: Open Word and Excel files without a download
2026-10-23-141.body: Press a Word (.docx) or Excel (.xlsx) file in Files & Links, a chat or a comment. It opens as a page or a table. You do not need to download it first. The view is close to the file, not exact.
